description: Add 1 hour, 24 hours, or 7 days to one active receive-only inbox without changing its address. Price: $0.05 for 3600, $0.20 for 86400, $1.00 for 604800 (additional_duration_seconds). Requires AUSCA_PRIVATE_KEY and AUSCA_MAX_PAYMENT_USD in this server's environment.

inputSchema.description: Extend one active inbox from its current expiry without changing its address or read/delete capability.

additional_duration_seconds.description: Time added to the existing expiry: 1 hour, 24 hours, or 7 days.

ausca_campaign.description: Optional self-reported campaign attribution; requires ausca_source.

ausca_idempotency_key.description: Required caller-owned purchase identity. Save before payment and reuse with unchanged input to recover an uncertain response. A different key authorizes another purchase.

ausca_source.description: Optional self-reported source attribution. Reporting only; never affects payment or execution.

expected_expires_at.description: Exact current expiry observed before preparing this extension; stale values are refused.

extension_authorization.description: Opaque extension-only authority returned with the original resource access. It cannot read or delete inbox content.

inbox_id.description: Active inbox identity returned by the original purchase.

inputSchema.title: Receive-only agent inbox extension input

name: ausca_extend_inbox
